verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a URL-to-markdown and search API. The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The `x-instruction` natural-language extraction via ReaderLM-v2 and VLM image captioning are model-powered processing features of the API, not an assistant that accepts and carries out delegated tasks, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
